_doc: Default gate thresholds. Copy to <workspace>/forge/gates.json to override per run. A required check that cannot run (tool missing, no data) FAILS - it never passes silently, and a threshold whose metric was not measured fails too. Verdict is PASS only when every required check passes AND overall_score >= min_overall_score. A file named in $FORGE_GATES_OVERRIDE is merged last (used by CI).

coverage._doc: Gated on changed lines since state.base_ref (diff-cover) when measurable; otherwise on overall line coverage against min_line_pct.

static._doc: SonarQube Community in Docker (scripts/sonar.py). Ratings: 1 = A ... 5 = E. null disables a threshold; a set threshold whose measure Sonar did not return fails. Sonar's own quality gate ('Sonar way') judges new code only, so on a project's first analysis it passes trivially - the overall measures above are what gate the code. Set min_coverage_pct once the scanner gets a coverage report (scanners.sonar.extra_args).

security._license_doc: Trivy licence findings rated CRITICAL (forbidden, e.g. AGPL) or HIGH (restricted, e.g. GPL). Needs installed deps (node_modules / site-packages) to see transitive licences.
security._doc: Semgrep + Gitleaks + Trivy (local or Docker, see scanners) + npm audit / pip-audit + hardcoded credentials (scripts/pii_scan.py) + the claude-security summary. A scanner that could not run fails the check.

pii._doc: PII/PHI in code, config and seed data (SSN, Aadhaar, PAN, cards, e-mail, phone, DOB) and PII values written to logs (scripts/pii_scan.py). Fake data: use allowlisted domains (config/pii-allowlist.json) or 'pii-allow: <reason>' on the line; allowed findings are listed and counted as pii_allowed.

review._doc: Code review of the diff since state.base_ref: built-in /code-review + code-modernization architecture-critic (ADR drift). Evidence: forge/evidence/code-review.json

database._doc: applies only when state.db_migration is true (opt-in); otherwise n/a

cost._doc: 0 = no limit. max_tokens: transcript tokens. max_usd / max_calls / max_usd_per_call: the headless-run ledger forge/cost/ledger.jsonl (cost_estimate.py record-claude), e.g. 25 / 10 / 5. A ledger entry whose cost could not be read fails the check.

commands._doc: Leave empty to auto-detect. Commands run with cwd = modernized code root. coverage_report = path (relative to that root) of lcov.info, cobertura/coverage.xml or jacoco.xml (these also enable changed-line coverage), or coverage-summary.json (Istanbul) / coverage.json (coverage.py) for overall only.

scanners._doc: prefer: auto (local tool if installed, else Docker) | local | docker. Images: pin a version or digest for reproducible before/after numbers; the digest actually used is recorded in raw/tool-versions.json either way.

sonar._doc: extra_args: scanner properties, e.g. "-Dsonar.javascript.lcov.reportPaths=coverage/lcov.info" or "-Dsonar.coverage.jacoco.xmlReportPaths=target/site/jacoco/jacoco.xml". Java: compiled classes under target/classes or build/classes are found automatically (build first).
